content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 16.2 (p0281) is a deviation — indeed walk-away territory. It bars IBM from assigning without MSL's prior written approval, with no affiliate carve-out, no merger/asset-sale carve-out, and no reasonableness standard on MSL's approval; the only "not unreasonably withheld" standard runs in MSL's favour for MSL Related Company assignments. It therefore fails the fallback too (no mutual successor-assignment-on-notice right).

**Other locations checked:** §16.5 (p0290) requires any MSL acquirer to assume the Agreement — favourable, not flagged. Loan Agreement §16 (p1578) restricts MSL only — favourable. The confidentiality-agreement general clause (p1494) is a separate ancillary instrument; not redlined. No change-of-control termination or re-pricing right exists anywhere.

**Cure:** a single inserted sentence pair at the end of §16.2 giving IBM affiliate and successor assignment rights without MSL approval, confirming no MSL termination right on an IBM change of control, barring MSL assignments to IBM competitors, and adding a reasonableness standard to IBM's approval of other MSL assignments. MSL's existing consent requirement was cited as already met rather than restated.
